description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC REST controller named CustomerRESTController, which provides REST endpoints for managing customer data within a merchant store context. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, and deleting customers, as well as for handling customer options and option values.

classes.name: CustomerRESTController
classes.description: Spring MVC REST controller managing customer-related endpoints for a merchant store, including CRUD operations for customers and customer options.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a customer's details by ID within a specified merchant store.

methods.name: createCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Creates a new customer option value for a specified merchant store.

methods.name: createCustomerOption
methods.description: Creates a new customer option for a specified merchant store.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Retrieves all customers associated with a specified merchant store.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer by ID within a specified merchant store.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer in a specified merchant store, assigns default groups and password, and sends registration email.
